verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law-firm and platform service, so documenting dependent visas (O-3, H-4, dependent work authorization) is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions dependents, spouses, children, O-3, H-4 or EAD filings. Its visa guides and case-management claims cover only principal petitions, so the applicable capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service
